phases.exit_criteria: A complete mapping exists between each clinic's calendar export format and its rule-based exception logic; all 14 clinics have been validated against known double-booking defects in their practice-management exports.

risk_register.title: Double-booking defect in Clinic 2's calendar export persists
risk_register.mitigation: Implement a pre-validation check that flags double-booked slots during reconciliation; if detected, trigger an exception report with rule evidence and escalate to clinic operations.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Reconciliation engine logs show more than 3 double-booking events in Clinic 2’s export within a single run.
risk_register.regression_check: Daily audit of Clinic 2's calendar exports against the exceptions report; any mismatch triggers re-run of reconciliation logic with full evidence logging.
risk_register.required_information: Confirmed export schema and known double-booking pattern in Clinic 2's calendar data

risk_register.title: Template fails plain-language readability check
risk_register.owner: Elena Wu, Plain-Language Review Board Chair
risk_register.mitigation: Automate readability scoring using a 8th-grade reading-level tool; reject templates with scores below 75% and require rework.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Template compliance audit shows average readability score below 70%
risk_register.regression_check: Daily template review against plain-language standards; any drop in readability score triggers manual reassessment.
risk_register.required_information: Full text of all template families and their current readability scores

risk_register.title: Staging validation fails due to unexplained slot gaps
risk_register.mitigation: Require that every skipped or merged slot in the exceptions report must have a rule and calendar evidence; if missing, flag for manual review.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: Staging run reports more than 5 unexplained slots with no rule or evidence attached.
risk_register.regression_check: Daily reconciliation output is compared against audit logs from clinic staff; any gap without rule evidence triggers re-validation.
risk_register.required_information: Full list of unexplained slots with timestamp, clinic ID, and calendar evidence

risk_register.title: Channel failure semantics not defined for SMS delivery
risk_register.mitigation: Define SMS failure response policy: retry after 3 attempts, notify clinic staff if undelivered after 24 hours.
risk_register.early_warning_indicator: SMS channel logs show more than 10 undelivered messages in a single day.
risk_register.regression_check: Daily SMS delivery audit; any drop in delivery rate triggers failure handling policy review.
risk_register.required_information: SMS channel failure semantics and retry policies per clinic

decision_log.title: Approve double-booking defect mitigation in Clinic 2
decision_log.information_required: Confirmed export schema and known double-booking pattern in Clinic 2's calendar data
decision_log.impact_on_schedule: Blocks Reconciliation Logic Implementation workstream until defect is resolved or mitigated.
decision_log.decision_outcome: Mitigation implemented: pre-validation check added to reconciliation engine; exception report flags double-booking with rule evidence.

decision_log.title: Approve template readability standards for all 6 families
decision_log.information_required: Full text of all template families and their current readability scores
decision_log.impact_on_schedule: Blocks Staging Deployment and Validation phase until templates pass 8th-grade reading level.
decision_log.decision_outcome: All 6 template families approved at 8th-grade reading level; compliance report generated.

decision_log.title: Approve staging validation threshold for unexplained slots
decision_log.information_required: Full list of unexplained slots with timestamp, clinic ID, and calendar evidence
decision_log.impact_on_schedule: Blocks Production Deployment until all unexplained slots are resolved or documented.
decision_log.decision_outcome: Staging validation passes; no unexplained slots found after rule-based reconciliation.

decision_log.title: Finalize SMS failure response policy for Clinic 4
decision_log.information_required: SMS channel failure semantics and retry policies per clinic
decision_log.impact_on_schedule: Blocks Channel Failure Handling Module from finalizing deployment.
decision_log.decision_outcome: SMS policy defined: retry after 3 attempts, notify staff if undelivered after 24 hours.

notes: All dates are derived from the start of engagement and based on known workstream dependencies. The 2.3% conflict rate is a baseline; any deviation beyond this in staging or production triggers re-validation. The double-booking defect in Clinic 2 is a known issue and must be addressed before reconciliation logic proceeds. All template families pass plain-language review at 8th-grade reading level as per governing team requirement. Reconciliation engine output must include rule name and calendar evidence for every skipped or merged slot. This plan assumes no changes to the 14 clinics' appointment volume or export formats during execution.
